svg.title: Awesome Hacker News Data: every HackerTube for X, the datasets behind them, and the gotchas in the data
svg.desc: Unofficial list of 76 projects and 9 datasets. Example rows: HackerTube, 6,454 YouTube videos, source open-index; HackerBooks, about 16.5k books, source not stated; HackerPods, podcasts, source Algolia API; HackTok, a vertical video feed, source HackerTube data.
